name: b_molddirty
prompt: Close view of the lower corner of a tiled hotel shower: beige-cream wall tiles with gray grout lines and a white silicone caulk line along the bottom where the tiles meet the white shower tray, heavily covered in black mold spots and speckles along the caulk and creeping up the grout, damp, lit by the bathroom ceiling light. name: b_shower
prompt: A hotel guest shower seen from the bathroom at eye level: beige-cream ceramic wall tiles, gray grout, a white shower tray, a chrome shower head and a folded white towel on a chrome bar, warm ceiling light. Nobody in the room.

name: b_showerwide
prompt: A small hotel bathroom seen from the doorway: a tiled shower on the left with a white plastic shower curtain half open, a white ceiling above, a folded white towel on a chrome bar on the right wall, a mirror and sink, warm ceiling light. name: b_grouttile

name: b_counter
